body.message:
April 10 works, you can move in from that date.

For a 1-month stay, the rate is AED 7,000/month, all-inclusive. VAT, water, electricity, and internet are all covered, nothing extra on top.

On the AED 6,000, that's below what we can do here. The rate is firm at 7,000 all-in, which is solid value given everything is included.

Want to come see the apartment before we move forward?
